title: coap-secure (port 5684) large-datagram receive-path probe over TSCH on EMULATED nRF52840-DK

test.description: Node 1 is the coap-secure server (root/coordinator) built with COAP_UIP_RX_DEBUG. Node 2 blasts raw UDP datagrams of increasing size (700..1000 B) at node 1's port 5684, straight onto the coap-uip dispatch path. The size at which node 1's '[COAP-UIP] newdata ... len=' lines stop appearing (while 6LoWPAN still reassembles) is where the coap async receive path drops the large datagram.
